description: This file defines the MultipartStream class, which implements StreamInterface to represent a streaming multipart/form-data payload, typically used for uploading files and form data in HTTP requests. It manages the construction of multipart boundaries, headers, and stream content parts.

classes.name: MultipartStream
classes.description: A stream implementation that constructs and provides a multipart/form-data payload, handling boundary syntax, headers, and content streams for uploading interconnected form data parts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a MultipartStream with a list of form elements and optionally a boundary string. It creates an internal stream composing all parts.

methods.name: getBoundary
methods.description: Returns the boundary string used to separate multipart parts.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Indicates that this stream is not writable, returning false.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Generates the headers for a single multipart element, including the boundary separation.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Constructs the entire multipart stream by adding each element and a final boundary.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a single form element to the stream, including headers and content, with support for filename and headers.

methods.name: createElement
methods.description: Creates headers and stream object for an individual form-data part, setting default headers if not provided.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves a specific header value case-insensitively from an array of headers.
